Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Southwestern Vintage Area Rug, 7' 10" x 11', Multi
Materials: stone
Brighten your room with this beautiful area rug. With a Southwest-inspired design, this rug blends well with several home-decor styles, including Southwestern, contemporary, modern, and vintage, and its blue, orange, and red hues add a splash of color to the room. 7'10" x 11' Polypropylene Frisee Machine made 0.33 Med
